purpose: Constructive known-baseline feasibility diagnosis, not a new strategy ranking
conditional_admission: Each allocator requires its own no-fault physical/guard pass before its fault; otherwise NOT_RUN_PENDING_REVIEW
all_other_constraints: Same frozen six-model protocol, queue, nominal PI/PLL/source control and common antiwindup. Fixed N,K,Omega,terminal,legal disturbances,control clock and hard thresholds.
information: Same present current/PCC voltage/DC voltage/queue and nominal controller states. No future event/clearance or clean workload labels.
required_tests_before_physical_run: Original allocator passthrough full-state equality with identity guard
Common Kaw correction and immutable first hold
scoring: Absolute request errors and matched own-allocator reference differences; actual electrical limits and energy separately; unchanged conservative recovery with guard intervention counted as active limiting
numerical_refinement: Same-case5us only for hard contact/near-boundary audit, no extra physical scenarios
stopping_interpretation: Failure of both does not establish universal fast-port impossibility; successful known baseline reduces algorithmic novelty rather than proving it.
